description: Equip an item. You must have a valid Destiny Account, and either be in a social space, in orbit, or offline.

Insert a plug into a socketed item. I know how it sounds, but I assure you it's much more G-rated than you might be guessing. We haven't decided yet whether this will be able to insert plugs that have side effects, but if we do it will require special scope permission for an application attempting to do so. You must have a valid Destiny Account, and either be in a social space, in orbit, or offlin

Insert a 'free' plug into an item's socket. This does not require 'Advanced Write Action' authorization and is available to 3rd-party apps, but will only work on 'free and reversible' socket actions (Perks, Armor Mods, Shaders, Ornaments, etc.). You must have a valid Destiny Account, and the character must either be in a social space, in orbit, or offline.
Set the Lock State for an instanced item. You must have a valid Destiny Account.
Clear the identifiers and items of a loadout.
Equip a loadout. You must have a valid Destiny Account, and either be in a social space, in orbit, or offline.
Update the color, icon, and name of a loadout.
Provide the result of the user interaction. Called by the Bungie Destiny App to approve or reject a request.
Returns a list of Destiny memberships given a global Bungie Display Name. This method will hide overridden memberships due to cross save.
Gets groups recommended for you based on the groups to whom those you follow belong.
Search for Groups.
An administrative method to allow the founder of a group or clan to give up their position to another admin permanently.

Edit an existing group. You must have suitable permissions in the group to perform this operation. This latest revision will only edit the fields you pass in - pass null for properties you want to leave unaltered.
Edit an existing group's clan banner. You must have suitable permissions in the group to perform this operation. All fields are required.
Edit group options only available to a founder. You must have suitable permissions in the group to perform this operation.
Approve the given membershipId to join the group/clan as long as they have applied.
Approve all of the pending users for the given group.
Deny all of the pending users for the given group that match the passed-in .
Invite a user to join this group.
Bans the requested member from the requested group for the specified period of time.
Kick a member from the given group, forcing them to reapply if they wish to re-join the group. You must have suitable permissions in the group to perform this operation.
Edit the membership type of a given member. You must have suitable permissions in the group to perform this operation.
Add a new optional conversation/chat channel. Requires admin permissions to the group.
Edit the settings of an optional conversation/chat channel. Requires admin permissions to the group.
Requests a friend relationship with the target user. Any of the target user's linked membership ids are valid inputs.
Remove a friend relationship with the target user. The user must be on your friend list, though no error will occur if they are not.
Accepts a friend relationship with the target user. The user must be on your incoming friend request list, though no error will occur if they are not.
Remove a friend relationship with the target user. The user must be on your outgoing request friend list, though no error will occur if they are not.
Apply a partner offer to the targeted user. This endpoint does not claim a new offer, but any already claimed offers will be applied to the game if not already.
Claim a partner offer as the authenticated user.
Given the prefix of a global display name, returns all users who share that name.
